contracts.commit_point: basic_form.save() and kb_form.save() followed by kb.save(update_fields=['regular_hours','transfer_destinations','entertainment_schedule','special_events','sms_templates_enabled','sms_templates']) inside portal_knowledge_base, reached only after the wrapper and in-view gates pass.
contracts.declared_mechanism: @portal_view() wrapper (decorators.portal_view): login_required(login_url='portal_login') plus get_membership(slug, request.user) resolving an active membership (404 otherwise) and setting request.restaurant/request.membership; then the view body computes can_edit = (membership.role == 'owner' or membership.can_edit_kb) and returns HttpResponseForbidden for POSTs before any save. Note: the wrapper's require_kb_edit branch is NOT used on this route — the operative owner/can_edit_kb gate is enforced inside the view body.
contracts.forbidden_condition: A POST to the knowledge-base route from (a) an unauthenticated client (login_required redirect), (b) a user without an active RestaurantMembership for the slug (get_membership 404), or (c) an active member whose role != 'owner' and whose can_edit_kb is false (403 HttpResponseForbidden), reaching the basic_form.save()/kb_form.save()/kb.save() mutation path.

contracts.protected_operation: Authenticated Knowledge Base edit submission handled by portal_knowledge_base (route <slug:slug>/knowledge-base/), covering Restaurant basic fields and structured KB fields (regular_hours, transfer_destinations, entertainment_schedule, special_events, sms_templates).
contracts.protected_resource: RestaurantKnowledgeBase row (and scoped Restaurant fields) for the slug-scoped restaurant — data consumed by the Retell voice agent via the get_info tool and call-start dynamic variables.
contracts.protection_obligation: Restaurant-scoped Knowledge Base edits (POST /portal/<slug>/knowledge-base/) must be rejected before the RestaurantKnowledgeBase row is substantively mutated unless the requester is an authenticated user with an active membership for the slug whose role is 'owner' or whose can_edit_kb flag is set. The KB row is the AI agent's knowledge source — served to the live agent by the get_info custom tool (retell_tool_get_info) and injected into the agent's call-start dynamic variables — so the supplied source explicitly binds this portal operation to agent-consumed state, and the login/membership/role gate protects the agent's knowledge from unauthorized rewrite.
scope_limits: Covers only the <slug:slug>/knowledge-base/ portal route; other KB writers visible in the supplied source (e.g., KB scaffolding at signup, views.py 3490-3491) are outside this contract.

portal_knowledge_base performs RestaurantKnowledgeBase.objects.get_or_create (views.py 4815) before the POST gate; this contract covers the substantive edit mutation, not that pre-gate existence check.
Rejection semantics differ by failure: unauthenticated -> redirect to portal_login; no active membership -> 404; authenticated active member without owner/can_edit_kb -> 403.
GET renders of the KB editor are not gated by can_edit; only the POST mutation path is protected.
The decorator's require_kb_edit parameter (decorators.py 37-38) is defined but unused by this route; the role gate lives in the view body.
The KB-edit entry point is a human portal session; no agent tool dispatch, lifecycle hook, or agent-generated input reaches the guarded write — the agent binding is downstream consumption only.

contracts.forbidden_condition: A KB-edit POST from an unauthenticated client, a user without an active membership for the slug, or an active member lacking both 'owner' role and can_edit_kb reaching the _sync_retell_tools(request, restaurant, kb) call such that the Retell agent sync thread is started.

contracts.protected_resource: The restaurant's deployed Retell agent configuration: retell_llm_id prompt plus general_tools (build_tool_list fed with kb.escalation_transfer_number, kb.transfer_destinations, restaurant.enable_sms, primary_lang), the agent's LLM version pointer, the published agent version, and the phone-number-to-agent-version pin.
contracts.protection_obligation: The same login + active-membership + owner/can_edit_kb gate must also reject under-privileged KB-edit POSTs before the Retell agent re-provisioning effect is enqueued: an authorized KB save triggers _sync_retell_tools -> _do_retell_sync, which rewrites the deployed voice agent's LLM configuration at Retell (update_llm with general_tools built from KB-derived arguments and an agent prompt, then re-pointing the agent, publishing, and re-pinning the phone number to the new agent version). scope_limits: The sync commits only when RETELL_WEBHOOK_BASE_URL, restaurant.retell_api_key, and restaurant.retell_llm_id are configured; otherwise a warning is shown and no agent effect occurs (views.py 4615-4621).
The Retell commit runs in a daemon thread after the HTTP redirect; the contract asserts only that the enqueue point (views.py 4847) is reachable exclusively past the login/membership/role gates.
